functions.name: sub_02027010

struct_accesses.meaning: FSArchive.fat (FS_FindArchive result) <- header[0x48] FAT rom offset

functions.notes: Already declared void sub_02027010(void) in include/unk_02027010.h; only C caller is src/system.c:136. Logic: if (!FS_IsAvailable()) { OS_Terminate(); return; } then if *(u32*)0x027FF00C != 0x4A414441 ('ADAJ' = Diamond JP gamecode): CARD_Init(); MI_CpuCopy8((void*)0x027FFE00 /*HW_ROM_HEADER_BUF*/, (void*)0x027FF000, 0x160); MI_CpuCopy8((void*)0x027FFE00, (void*)0x027FFA80, 0x160); *(u32*)0x027FF00C = 0x4A414441. Then FSArchive *arc = FS_FindArchive("rom", 3); patch arc->fat/fat_size/fnt/fnt_size from the cached header at 0x027FF000 (OSThreadQueue is 8 bytes so fat is at 0x2c in this SDK's FSArchive, see lib/include/nitro/fs/archive.h). Finally validate cached header: u32 at +0xc == 0x4A414441 AND u16 at +0x10 == 0x3130 ('01' maker code), else OS_Terminate(). Constant 0x160 in C normally emits mov #0x16; lsl #4 in thumb so plain 0x160 literal should match. Hardcoded addresses likely expressed via HW_* macros (0x027FFE00 = HW_ROM_HEADER_BUF) or raw casts.

functions.name: sub_02027098

struct_accesses.meaning: FSFile.prop.file.top of stack-local FSFile after FS_OpenFile; stored to *(u32*)0x027FFC2C

functions.notes: Signature confirmed by existing extern at src/application/main_menu/main_menu.c:130 ('extern void sub_02027098(const char *path);') called with "data/eoo.dat" at line 1503. Body: FSFile file (on stack, frame 0x48); FS_InitFile(&file); if (FS_OpenFile(&file, path)) { *(u32*)0x027FFC2C = file.prop.file.top; OS_ResetSystem(0); }. No early return value; void. Soft-reset-to-embedded-boot-image (DS Download Play demo eoo.dat) mechanism.

notes: Tiny 2-function thumb file (~0xB0 bytes text), no .data/.bss, single 4-byte rodata string. Purpose: ROM-header caching / 'ADAJ' (Pokemon Diamond JP) header spoof for the DS Download Play demo path, plus soft-reset into files/data/eoo.dat. Both exported signatures are already pinned by existing C callers (src/system.c:136 and src/application/main_menu/main_menu.c:1503), so IPA risk is low as long as those exact prototypes are kept. The FSArchive field stores at 0x2c-0x38 map to fat/fat_size/fnt/fnt_size (lib/include/nitro/fs/archive.h lines 119-145); writing them as arc->fat = ... etc. is the intended C. Function order in C must be sub_02027010 then sub_02027098.
